name: str_replace_based_edit_tool
description: View and edit the learner's files: the data folder, its root "/" (the six databases at the top, the app's files under app/: your content under app/modules, app/packs, app/scenes, app/stories, app/readings, app/villagers, app/arrivals, app/grammar, app/cards, app/course/<unit>, app/scenarios). Commands: view (a file with numbered lines, view_range [start, end] for a part, end -1 to the end; a directory: its entries two levels deep), create (a whole file, file_text; an existing one is rewritten, its old text kept), str_replace (old_str exactly once in the file → new_str), insert (insert_text after line insert_line, 0 for the start). Writes only in those content areas, and every write is checked by its kind's validator first (the same as the publish tools): a refusal says what's wrong and nothing is written; fix it and write again. Prefer the publish tools for new content (they version modules and announce it); use the file tools to read your earlier content and for small fixes in it. The six databases are read-only (record_session and card write them); keys, tokens, the lease and the app's runtime files are out of reach.

path.description: Relative to the learner's data folder ("app/stories/my-story.json", "/" its root).

view_range.description: view: [start, end], 1-based lines; end -1 to the end of the file.

old_str.description: str_replace: the text to replace, exactly as it is in the file (once).

insert_line.description: insert: the line to insert after (0: at the start).
